question: When an agent/pre-step listener returns {kind:"reject"}, what does the harness UI draw for that turn? BS-17 asked this after R23 measured only the headless profile.

probe.bundle: .tmp/prestep-probe (one inserted row, id probe-pre-step, name prestep-probe)
probe.renderer: the @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app bundle the desktop shell loads, served by `dsh web` and driven through the Chrome DevTools Protocol in a headless Chrome

reject.observed_rendering: one line: "已完成，用时 1秒" (completed, 1s). No user bubble, no assistant bubble, no error, no reason. The typed message is not shown because the claim was consumed.

control.observed_rendering: the user bubble "Reply with exactly: OK", then "已完成，用时 7秒", then the assistant bubble "OK".

passthrough.observed_rendering: the user bubble and the assistant "OK" are drawn, then the turn ends with "处理失败 / 本轮运行失败 next is not a function / UNKNOWN".

findings: The desktop renderer draws a rejected turn as a completed turn. "已完成，用时 1秒" is the same completion line the control run prints after a real answer; the only difference is that the rejection has no user bubble and no assistant bubble.

The user input is gone from the window: the reject run has removedCount 1 with no inserted message and no user/message afterwards, and the UI has nothing to show for it. A person cannot tell whether the turn did anything or failed.

A listener that wants to pass through cannot simply `return next()` on this seam in this host build: the passthrough run answered OK and then ended with turn/end reason kind "error", message "next is not a function", code UNKNOWN. The reject path never calls next(), which is why R23 did not see this.
not_proven: The Electron shell itself was not driven: the measurement uses the web app bundle the desktop shell loads, served by `dsh web`, so window chrome and native menus are outside it.
One provider route (opendesign / deepseek-v4.1-flash-eco), one prompt, one turn per run.
A rejection inside a multi-step turn, and a rejection after a tool call, were not exercised.

verdict.because: the window reports the rejected turn as completed while showing nothing that happened, and the pass-through contract of the seam is not `return next()` in this build
verdict.usable_for: rewriting the message with {kind:"enter"} only, and only after that path is measured
